analysis.cfg_to_pda: Standard one-state NPDA: epsilon-expand a nonterminal, match a terminal at stack top, accept by empty stack.
analysis.pda_simulator: Breadth-first configuration exploration with accepting-path reconstruction and a maximum-configuration bound.

arithmetic_expression.parser: LL(1) predictive PDA; multiplication has higher precedence than addition; operators associate left
arithmetic_expression.determinism: Predictive LL(1) PDA is deterministic; the standard CFG-to-PDA construction is nondeterministic in general.

assignment_statement.pda: Deterministic LL(1) predictive PDA starting at S, then reusing the expression grammar.

balanced_parentheses.pda: One-state DPDA with an initially empty working stack: push a marker for each '(' and pop for ')' only when '(' is on top; accept after all input when the working stack is empty.

ambiguity_witness_only.purpose: Demonstrate two groupings for id + id * id; this grammar is not used by the accepted-input parser.
